prompt: 我现在想做一个小红书的博主数据采集工作流，跟之前抖音那个类似。我需要抓取博主信息、所有笔记、如果是图文就做OCR、视频就转文字、然后打标签出报告。帮我设计这个工作流应该分成哪些skill，怎么编排。
expected: 工作流设计文档：区分复用和平台特定能力，提供原子skill拆分、编排步骤、输入输出契约与失败处理。

prompt: We have one giant customer-document intake skill. It downloads email attachments, virus-scans them, OCRs PDFs, extracts invoice fields, sends uncertain fields to a reviewer, writes records to our accounting API, and posts a Slack summary. Changing OCR behavior keeps breaking the accounting step. Refactor this into a maintainable skill architecture. We need safe retries because the workflow can resume after a crash.
expected: Generalized refactor plan: coherent atomic boundaries, thin orchestrator, human-review checkpoint, contracts, idempotency, and resumability.

prompt: Design a release workflow skill for our web app. It should run tests and a build in parallel, stop if either fails, deploy to staging, run smoke checks, wait for human approval, deploy production, and post a release note. Please avoid splitting every shell command into its own skill.
expected: Practical orchestration design: parallel steps, failure stops, human approval checkpoint, and sensible skill granularity.
